name: AWQ
tagline: Activation-aware weight-only quantization: per-channel scale search using calibration activations, then per-group max-clip search before symmetric quantization.
diff_from_baseline: Lin et al. 2024 (AWQ, MLSys). Activation-aware weight quantization that scales salient (high-activation) channels up before quantization to preserve them; here paired with per-group clip search. No Hessian needed.

name: GPTQ
tagline: Hessian-based column-wise PTQ: quantize one column at a time and propagate the error to remaining columns using $H^{-1}$ to minimize layer output error.
diff_from_baseline: Frantar et al. 2023 (GPTQ, ICLR). One-shot Hessian-based PTQ using OBQ-style per-column updates with block-wise Cholesky. The dominant accurate-low-bit baseline for LLMs.

name: RTN
tagline: Symmetric per-channel (or per-group) round-to-nearest quantization with no calibration data.
diff_from_baseline: Jacob et al. 2018 (CVPR). Round-to-Nearest quantization: simplest possible PTQ baseline, no calibration, zero overhead. Reference floor for any low-bit method.
